description: Use this to understand a public procurement market before choosing where to bid: the largest awards, supplier concentration (top-3 share, HHI), fastest-growing categories, award versus estimate, single-bidder and direct-award shares, and live open Compras Ágiles with no quote yet, plus amount_anomalies: awards whose recorded amount is out of range (left out of totals, listed to verify at the source). Each signal has a neutral statement, its number, the change against the previous period, an implication for a supplier and suggested_next_calls. Pass category as a UNSPSC code ('42', '4213') or a name ('equipamiento medico'), and period as last_12m (default), a year ('2025') or a quarter ('2025-Q3'). Built from awarded tenders (OCDS), which lag months: every signal states data_as_of. Anonymous agents get one market-wide signal per call. Access: open to anonymous agents (rate-limited); a free AndesPass key raises the limit.
name: market_signals
title: Market signals
